item.title: Iran launches 10 natural gas industry projects with $350m investment
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran has commissioned 10 natural gas industry projects under five development plans, backed by $350 million in investment, to increase daily production capacity by 32 million cubic meters of sweet gas.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86334496/Iran-launches-10-natural-gas-industry-projects-with-350m-investment

Tehran, IRNA — Iran has commissioned 10 natural gas industry projects under five development plans, backed by $350 million in investment, to increase daily production capacity by 32 million cubic meters of sweet gas.

item.title: Iranian Navy chief says wartime blockade signals adversary’s failure
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Navy commander, Rear Admiral Shahram Irani, says a maritime blockade imposed during the war signals that the opposing side has failed to achieve its objectives, adding that Iran will face no geographical limits in operations under directives issued by the country’s leader.

item.title: IRGC Navy: Two violating tankers explode near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says two tankers exploded and caught fire near the entrance to Khasab Port and east of the Strait of Hormuz after attempting to cross the strategic waterway through an unauthorized route.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86334293/IRGC-Navy-Two-violating-tankers-explode-near-Strait-of-Hormuz

Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy says two tankers exploded and caught fire near the entrance to Khasab Port and east of the Strait of Hormuz after attempting to cross the strategic waterway through an unauthorized route.

item.title: Iran, Turkey agree to expand security cooperation at Ankara meeting
item.description: Ankara, IRNA – Iran and Turkey have agreed to strengthen operational cooperation and information sharing on border security, counterterrorism and efforts to combat drug and arms smuggling during their eighth joint security meeting in Ankara.
